confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus or booking pages; no web search was used for city prices. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which assumes July low-season (rainy season) rates including taxes and fees. Cocktail and wine are set from the beer anchor at typical local ratios (about 2.75x and 3x). FX value is from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page for 15 Oct 2026; that page was not opened directly, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table. A 16 Oct figure from a third-party site was unverified and not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Southeast Asian basis anchored on Siem Reap's tourist core (Pub Street, Old Market, Wat Bo areas), informed by comparable tourist hubs such as Luang Prabang and Hoi An. Not derived from any web source.
